violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: French fried potatoes in the hot holding unit were 112°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The potatoes were reheated to 165°F and placed back in the hot holding unit. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: chicken tenders cooked yesterday were 65°F on the counter. According to the food employee, they were removed from the refrigerator less than 30 minutes ago. The chicken tenders were being placed onto sub rolls and wrapped in aluminum foil and placed back in the refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The wrapped sub rolls were placed in the freezer to allow them to cool faster. Ensure that the chicken cools to 41°F by 2 PM today. CDI.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the unisex rest room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Please provide a cover trashcan as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Hot Water and Chemical Sanitizing, Immersion Time
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia solution at the three compartment sink was 0 ppm. Therefore surfaces are not effectively sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Quaternary ammonia solutions must be maintained between 200 and 400 ppm at all times. The manager corrected this by remixing the solution which was 200 ppm before the inspection was completed.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: three squeeze bottles of ranch dressing in the 2-door Traulsen refrigerator were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The manager corrected this on site by labeling the bottles with a sharpie.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: The screen door on the loading dock has gaps at the bottom of it, which would allow pests to enter the kitchen. The interior door was propped open, and the screen door was closed.
violations.corrective_action: Please submit a work order to have the door sweep replaced to prevent pests from entering the kitchen from outside. Correct as soon as possible or within six months. PINE SPRING ELEMENTARY SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 11/07/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. The quaternary ammonia concentration for the wiping cloth solution was 0 ppm, therefore the wiping cloths were being stored in water.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The manager corrected this by remixing all the wiping cloth bucket solutions.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no cover to the feminine napkin refuse container in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Please install a second smaller trashcan with a lid for feminine hygiene products or provide a lid for the current trashcan in the employee restroom. Correct within six months.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: The outside dumpster lid and door were both left open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. The lid and door were closed during the visit.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Soil buildup observed on interior of ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Please clean the ice machine as soon as possible, and increase the cleaning frequency of the machine.

violations.observation: Observed some mold buildup on interior of ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.
